svg.aria-label: Measured data: Darja Ruskule, SASBDB SASDAC2, credited under the database unrestricted-reuse policy. A plots positive intensities over the full range; B retains points inside and outside the fit; C scales residuals by archived errors; D varies the upper fit bound. Large initial errors remain visible; this chapter specifies its own analysis window.
